title: Learning to swim
instructions: Maria yetişkinken yüzmeyi öğrenmesini anlatıyor. Neden ve nasıl öğrendiğine dikkat et.

script.speaker: s
script.text: I didn't learn to swim when I was a child.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Last year, my daughter started swimming lessons, and I felt silly sitting by the pool.

script.speaker: s
script.text: So I joined an adult class on Tuesday evenings.

script.speaker: s
script.text: At first, I was afraid of deep water, but my teacher was very patient.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Now I can swim fifty metres without stopping!

questions.prompt: Why did Maria decide to learn to swim?
options: She felt silly sitting by the pool.
She wanted to go on holiday.
questions.feedback: Kızı yüzme derslerine başlayınca havuz kenarında oturmak ona saçma geldi.
questions.evidence: I felt silly sitting by the pool.

questions.prompt: How far can she swim now?
questions.evidence: Now I can swim fifty metres without stopping!
